plugin.name: Infinite Canvas
plugin.description: Compose existing generation plugins, automation actions, and canvas-only nodes into shareable workflows.
action.list.description: List infinite-canvas workflows saved in the current project.
action.get.description: Read one complete workflow JSON document from the current project.
action.save.description: Create or revision-update a complete workflow in the current project.
action.delete.description: Delete one canvas workflow from the current project.
action.import_asset.description: Persist local media dropped onto the canvas in the current project library.
action.agent_skills.description: List plugin-owned skills available to the Infinite Canvas agent node.
action.agent_run.description: Run a canvas agent using the system LLM or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
action.condition_run.description: Evaluate judgement text as Success or Failure; Success passes the upstream payload through unchanged.
